steps.note: Scroll under cursor: the wheel must act on whatever the pointer is over, located by a row's own text rather than a coordinate. The viewport is deliberately short so the table overflows on every backend — note that how MANY rows fit is a backend detail, so the assertions only name rows that are on-screen either side of the scroll.
Scrolling back the same distance restores the original view — the wheel is symmetric, not a one-way ratchet.
